battle.name: 裴行儉攻伏念之戰
battle.brief: 開耀元年（681），阿史那伏念與阿史德溫傅據陰山、定襄反唐，高宗以裴行儉為定襄道行軍大總管討之。裴行儉以反間迫伏念執溫傅來降，餘眾悉平。卡面羅馬弩砲不臨此戰場，只標示一類扭力儲能、一發一具的重型投射器；此役拆開牙帳與木柵的，是唐軍的臂弩、床弩與穿甲箭。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 交戰的兩方是唐王朝與東突厥殘部。唐方由高宗下詔，中央以中書省擬詔、兵部調發兵仗與轉輸，戰線由定襄道行軍大總管裴行儉統一指揮，轄行軍副總管、諸道行軍總管與各鎮兵；兵源是關中、河東、河北、河南諸道徵發的府兵與募兵，另有附庸於唐的諸蕃部落兵員，裴行儉自己又在河南招募精騎萬餘。糧秣自河東、河北轉運至陰山前線，路途極遠，冬春積雪常把車隊堵在半路。突厥方沒有中原式的軍府，而是以阿史那伏念的牙帳為核心，阿史德溫傅自樹一幟，兩人各領部眾、互相猜忌又互相倚重；其下是陰山、定襄一帶大小部落的聯盟，騎兵為主力，兼用帳幕、革弓與馬群，靠游牧物資作戰，並無成套的攻城與守城器械。唐朝設定襄道為軍區，本就是為承接這類草原部眾而設，因此這是一場邊防行政體系與部族聯盟的對撞：一方靠郡兵、糧道與官僚體系長期駐紮，一方靠騎兵機動、逐水草而進退。雙方的番號、兵數與各次接戰的年月，傳世記載多有缺漏，諸說並存。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Tang dynasty and the rump of the Eastern Turks. On the Tang side the orders came from Emperor Gaozong, the central government drafted the edicts through the Secretariat and issued weapons and transport through the Ministry of War, and the front was held together by Pei Xingjian as Commander-in-Chief of the Marching Forces for the Dingxiang Circuit, with deputy commanders, circuit commanders and the troops of the various garrisons beneath him. The manpower was a mixture of militia and recruited men drawn from the capital districts, Hedong, Hebei and Henan, together with the contingents of the tribes submitted to Tang; Pei Xingjian himself raised more than ten thousand picked cavalry in Henan. Grain was moved from Hedong and Hebei to the front below the Yin Mountains, a very long haul whose convoys were often blocked half-way by winter snow. The Turkic side had nothing like a Chinese military administration: the core was the tent of Nasian Funi'an, the nephew of the last Eastern Turkic khagan, while Ashide Wenfu raised his own banner beside it, and the two men led separate groups of people while suspecting and leaning on each other at the same time. Beneath them lay a league of the greater and lesser clans of the Yin Mountains and Dingxiang, cavalry in the main, using tents, composite bows and herds of horses, fighting off the produce of pastoralism, with no settled apparatus either for siege or for fortification. The Tang had created the Dingxiang circuit as a military district precisely to absorb such pastoral peoples, so the war was in essence a collision between a frontier administrative system and a tribal confederation: one side had to hold ground for a long time on the strength of prefectural troops, supply lines and bureaucracy, the other moved on its own initiative and shifted with the grass and water. The unit names, the troop numbers and the months of the individual clashes survive only in fragmentary and conflicting form.
people: 核心人物是裴行儉（619—682），字守約，河東聞喜人，出身河東裴氏中眷房；父裴仁基、兄裴行儼皆隋末名將，隋末為王世充所殺，裴行儉出生在家族破敗之後。他少年從蘇定方學兵法，蘇定方對他說「吾用兵，世無可教者，今子也賢」，日後人們稱他的用兵奇正相濟。他以蔭補弘文生，又以明經入仕，歷西州長史、安西都護、吏部侍郎，永隆開耀間以定襄道行軍大總管統兵出討伏念。他帳下前後湧出張虔勗、程務挺、王方翼、郭待封、劉敬同、崔智辯、黨金毗、李多祚、黑齒常之、薛納等一批名將，後來多在唐與吐蕃、高句麗、突厥的戰場上獨當一面。敵方主腦阿史那伏念是東突厥末代可汗頡利的從兄之子，關內關外的突厥舊部多歸之；阿史德溫傅是與他並立的首領，據載二人同起而終為反間所離。史書對受降過程中每一道命令、每一位使者的具體經過多有分歧，可以確定的只有兩點：出謀與統軍者都是裴行儉，而最後的勝負由他自己設計的一次離間決定。
peopleEn: Pei Xingjian (619-682) is the figure at the centre of this story. His courtesy name was Shouyue; he was a native of Wenxi in Hedong and belonged to the middle branch of the Pei clan of Hedong. His father Pei Renji and his elder brother Pei Xingyan had both been famous generals of the Sui, and both were killed by Wang Shichong, so Pei Xingjian was born into a family that had already been ruined. He studied the art of war in youth under Su Dingfang, who said of him: 'In my use of troops there is no one I could teach; now you are the worthy one', and his later campaigning was praised for mixing the regular with the unexpected. He entered office through privilege as a student of the Hongwen Academy, took the degree in the Mingjing examination, and served in turn as Administrator of Xizhou, Protector-General of Anxi and Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel; in the Yonglong and Kaiyao years he was appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Marching Forces for the Dingxiang Circuit and led the army that campaigned against Funi'an. From his camp came a whole generation of famous generals, among them Zhang Qianxu, Cheng Wuting, Wang Fangyi, Guo Daifeng, Liu Jingtong, Cui Zhibian, Dang Jinpi, Li Duozuo, Heichi Changzhi and Xue Ne, who afterwards held independent commands in Tang wars against Tibet, Goguryeo and the Turks. On the enemy side the chief was Nasian Funi'an, a son of the brother of Jieli, the last khagan of the Eastern Turks, and to him many of the old Turkic clans inside and beyond the passes rallied; Ashide Wenfu was a chief who rose alongside him, and the two began together but were at last torn apart by the counter-plot. The records differ over the exact steps of the surrender, over which command was given and which messenger carried it, and only two things can be fixed: the man who devised the plan and who commanded the army was Pei Xingjian, and the final decision was settled by a piece of dissimulation that he himself designed.
kits: 卡面這具羅馬弩砲並不出現在唐與突厥的戰場上，它是同類投射器的標記。扭力弩砲是公元前二世紀羅馬城邦用來對付希臘城牆的兵器：木製機身張滿銅箍的扭力索，一具只發一支粗長重箭，射程約一百二十步，發後須重新上弦，因此常架在陣前的木製射位或隨軍車上，由數人操作。換到唐軍的器械體系裡，位置最接近的是床弩與車弩：唐弩以木弩機承力，弩臂長可達數尺，矢粗於弓矢而能穿甲，專門用來射穿木柵、城樓與皮甲，並與臂弩、掌弩、步弓搭配成數層投射；再外圍是拒馬、櫓車、巢車、撞車、雲梯這類進攻與防護器械，以及火矢一類燃燒器材。突厥方則以複合革弓配骨鍪皮甲，騎射與車帳並用，馬群、乳酪與肉乾就是他們的後勤。弩砲的真正戰術價值，在於把一次精準的重擊放在敵陣之前；唐軍在定襄線上倚重的同樣是這個位置上的東西，只是換成了弩與穿甲箭。
kitsEn: The Roman ballista on the card, the scorpio, did not stand on any battlefield in this war; it marks a class of weapon rather than an object. The torsion ballista was a device the Roman city-states built in the second century before Christ to break Hellenistic city walls: a wooden frame strung with twisted sinew held in bronze skeins, firing one thick bolt per shot to a range of about a hundred and twenty paces and needing to be re-cocked after every shot, so it was normally set on a timber firing platform in front of the line or carried on a cart with a crew to work it. Transposed into the Tang inventory, the nearest counterpart is the bed crossbow and the cart crossbow: the Tang draw took a wooden stock as its lock, the arm ran to several feet, the bolt was heavier than an arrow and could pierce armour, and it was used specifically to shoot through palisades, towers and leather armour, working in layers with hand crossbows, wrist crossbows and the ordinary bow. Outside that lay the closing pieces of the artillery line, the chevaux-de-frise, the wheeled mantlet, the siege tower, the battering ram and the scaling ladder, together with incendiary bolts. The Turks, for their part, used composite bows of horn and sinew with bone helmets and leather armour, combining mounted archery with the wagon laager, and their supply was the horse herd, the milk and the dried meat. The real tactical value of the ballista lay in putting one accurate heavy shot in front of the enemy line; what the Tang relied on at Dingxiang was the same thing in the same place, only the weapon there was the crossbow and the arming-piercing bolt.
tactics: 裴行儉的戰法以韜略、斷糧與奇襲為主。他接手時，伏念的騎兵依托陰山草原，唐軍每推進一步，糧道就拉長一段，冬季積雪、草場無糧，遠征補給極難，所以他的第一步不是硬打，而是使敵不得久據：分兵切斷馬群與牧地，逼突厥部眾在冬春之間失去依附。同時他不斷以巡騎、斥候搜索虛實，宿營必擇水草與可守之地，進退都有布置。歐洲式的布袋戰法在唐軍這裡就是「奇兵夜襲」：他在西域立功時曾以萬餘騎假作畋獵而近敵，選數百騎為奇兵由背後掩擊得手，同樣的思路在定襄線上用於合圍與突擊。中段最關鍵的一手是反間：借伏念與阿史德溫傅之間的猜忌，使兩人自相疑貳，終致伏念執溫傅而來降，全軍不戰而屈人之兵。收降之後他沒有解散部眾，而是分置各道，給以種食牛羊，令其屯耕安置，把軍事勝利轉成行政處置。運糧是全役最吃力的環節，他曾上疏力爭留軍，朝廷乃增發轉輸以支軍需。
tacticsEn: Pei Xingjian's method rested on concealment, cutting supplies and night attacks. When he took over, Funi'an's cavalry sat on the pastures of the Yin Mountains; every step the Tang army pushed forward stretched its supply line a little further, and in winter the snow and the bare grassland made the business of provisioning a distant army extremely hard, so his first move was not to force a decision but to make the enemy unable to stay: he split his force to cut off the horse herds and the grazing grounds and force the Turkic clans to lose their livelihood between winter and spring. At the same time he scoured the country with patrols and scouts, chose camp sites with water and grass that could be defended, and never advanced or withdrew without arrangement. The European way of closing a pocket corresponds in Tang practice to the surprise force used by night: when he made his name in the western regions he raised more than ten thousand horsemen under the guise of a hunt, brought them close to the enemy and sent several hundred picked riders to strike from behind, and the same way of thinking was used at Dingxiang in encirclement and assault. The decisive stroke in the middle of the campaign was the counter-plot: he used the mutual suspicion between Funi'an and Ashide Wenfu so that the two came to doubt each other, until at last Funi'an seized Wenfu and came in to surrender, a whole host won without a battle. After the surrender he did not disband the clans but settled them in several circuits, gave them seed grain and cattle and set them to plough and garrison, turning a military victory into an administrative arrangement. Moving the grain was the hardest part of the whole business; he petitioned hard to keep the army in the field, and the court increased the transport so that the war could be supplied.
data: 關於數字，必須分清「統兵之數」與「戰場之數」。史書記裴行儉以定襄道行軍大總管統兵三十萬出擊，這個數字包含各道徵發、番部附庸與沿途供應的後備人馬，並非集中在陰山前線的作戰兵力；實際投入野戰與圍城的應是數萬之眾，具體數目各書不一，通行說法是裴行儉在河南另募精騎萬餘。時間跨度則相當清楚：乾封元年（666）伏念與阿史德溫傅起兵，至開耀元年（681）反間成功，前後約十五年，其間裴行儉一度調任安西都護與吏部侍郎，又在吐蕃戰線上經歷大非川之敗，前線由他與後繼諸將輪番經營。結束的時間是開耀元年，餘眾悉平（本卡 battle.m 取四月，係按北疆春末用兵的慣例推算；史籍只記「開耀元年」，未載月日，故月份只作索引用途）。史籍沒有留下伏念部的確切兵員、被斬與被俘的數目，也沒有留下唐軍一方的傷亡統計；弓弩的儲備量、每日耗矢數、運糧車隊的編組與行程，各書亦無記載。本戰役最可靠的數字只有三個：統兵三十萬、徵募精騎萬餘、征戰十五年，其餘多屬推算，不宜當作確數。
dataEn: Numbers have to be separated into the troops mustered and the troops fought. The histories record that Pei Xingjian took the field as Commander-in-Chief of the Marching Forces for the Dingxiang circuit with three hundred thousand men. That figure covers the levies of the various circuits, the attached tribal contingents and the reserve and supply personnel along the route; it is not the number concentrated below the Yin Mountains. The force actually engaged in the field and in the siege was in the tens of thousands, the exact figure differing from book to book, and the commonly repeated statement is that Pei Xingjian raised more than ten thousand picked cavalry in Henan. The span of time is much clearer: Funi'an and Ashide Wenfu rose in Qianfeng 1 (666) and the counter-plot succeeded in Kaiyao 1 (681), roughly fifteen years, during which Pei Xingjian was transferred to the Protectorate of Anxi and to the Ministry of Personnel and suffered the defeat at Dafeichuan on the Tibetan front, the line being held in turn by him and by his successors. The end came in Kaiyao 1, when the remaining clans were all settled. The records leave no exact count of Funi'an's men, of the slain or of the prisoners, and no casualty figure for the Tang side; they say nothing about the stores of bows and bolts, the arrows spent each day, or the composition and daily distance of the grain convoys. Only three figures rest on solid ground: three hundred thousand men mustered, more than ten thousand picked cavalry raised, and fifteen years of campaigning. Everything else is estimate and should not be treated as exact.
cause: 起因要從東突厥降唐以後說起。頡利可汗於貞觀四年（630）被唐軍擒獲，次年內遷，其部眾被置於陰山、定襄一帶，授官給糧，編入唐的羈縻與都督府體系。表面上的編戶齊民之下，舊部豪酋對唐廷的羈縻安排並不服氣，隨著時間推移，邊州官員的貪污、部落饑饉與馬價的騰貴，都讓不滿累積。乾封元年（666），阿史德溫傅與阿史那伏念趁邊防空虛、北方諸部騷動之際舉兵反唐，據陰山、定襄，南窺河東，北聯諸部，一度聲勢不小。裴行儉奉詔出任定襄道行軍大總管，率兵三十萬討之。但雙方實力結構根本不同：唐軍是步騎混編、依賴糧道與城池的王朝遠征軍，突厥是可以在草原上轉戰千里的部族聯盟，後者的速度遠勝於前者的補給線。由此一場平叛被拖成十五年的持久戰。朝廷屢有還師之議，裴行儉力主留軍，才換來繼續經營定襄線的可能，戰局也才在最後以不戰而勝收束。
causeEn: The origins of the war lie in what followed the submission of the Eastern Turks. Jieli khagan was taken prisoner by Tang forces in Zhenguan 4 (630) and moved inland the following year; his people were settled around the Yin Mountains and Dingxiang, given offices and grain, and folded into the Tang system of client states and commanderies. Beneath the appearance of pacified and registered subjects, the old tribal magnates were not reconciled to the way the court ruled them, and as time passed the greed of the frontier officials, hunger among the clans and the soaring price of horses piled up grievances. In Qianfeng 1 (666) Ashide Wenfu and Nasian Funi'an seized the moment when the frontier was thin and the northern clans in turmoil, raised troops against Tang, occupied the Yin Mountains and Dingxiang, looked south towards Hedong and tied themselves to the other clans, and for a time looked imposing. Pei Xingjian was then appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Marching Forces for the Dingxiang Circuit and took three hundred thousand men against them. But the two sides were not at all alike in structure: the Tang army was a distant expedition of a settled dynasty, mixing foot and horse and depending on supply lines and walled towns, while the Turks were a tribal confederation able to fight a thousand li on the grasslands, far faster than the Tang supply line could follow. A revolt was thus turned into a fifteen-year war of attrition. The court argued more than once for pulling the army out; only Pei Xingjian's insistence on holding the position made it possible to keep the Dingxiang front, and only there was the campaign finally closed without a battle.
impact: 此役的結果，是唐在定襄道、陰山一線的邊患得到一次徹底清理。伏念與阿史德溫傅被平定之後，唐廷得以把降眾與其渠帥分置各道，編入都督府與羈縻州縣，配給種糧牛羊，令其屯耕，草原上的游牧部眾自此大批轉為編戶式的邊地居民。定襄道的軍事存在因此固定下來，從陰山到河東的牧場與通道納入唐的巡檢與屯田體系，絲路北道與河東的安全也一併改善。對裴行儉個人而言，這是他一生用兵藝術的總結與頂峰，高宗詔稱其「行儉提孤軍，深入萬里，兵不血刃而叛黨擒夷，可謂文武兼備矣」，授禮部尚書兼檢校右衛大將軍。他帳下那一批將領在隨後二十年的邊戰中接連嶄露頭角，唐代名將的譜系因此得以延續。更深一層的反間術價值在於，它為中原兵書留下一種典範：以最小的兵員消耗換取最大的政治效果，後來修兵書、講謀略者屢屢引此為例。不過降眾的安置若失其道，日後亦可能成為新的亂源，這一點史家亦有論及。
impactEn: The outcome of this war was one thorough clearance of the frontier trouble on the Dingxiang and Yin Mountains lines. Once Funi'an and Ashide Wenfu were settled, the court was able to distribute the surrendered clans and their chiefs among the circuits, enrol them in commanderies and client prefectures, give them seed grain and cattle and set them to farm, and a great part of the pastoral population of the steppe was thereby turned into registered frontier households. The military presence of the Dingxiang circuit became permanent: the pastures between the Yin Mountains and Hedong were drawn into the Tang inspection and garrison-farm system, and the security of the northern silk road and of Hedong improved at the same time. For Pei Xingjian personally this was the summing up and the summit of his art, and Gaozong's edict said that 'Pei Xingjian led a lone army deep ten thousand li and took the rebels and destroyed the traitors without shedding blood; he may indeed be said to combine civil and military excellence', and he was made Minister of Rites and concurrently Inspector of the Right Imperial Guard. The generation of commanders who came out of his camp kept appearing in leading roles over the following twenty years of frontier war, so that the lineage of Tang generals was carried on. The deeper lesson of the counter-plot is that it left the Chinese literature on strategy a model: the smallest expenditure of men for the greatest political effect, cited again and again by later writers of military manuals. There was a risk in the other direction, since if the surrendered people were settled badly they could become a new source of disorder, a point the historians have also raised.
result: 開耀元年（681），裴行儉的反間奏效：阿史那伏念與阿史德溫傅反目，伏念執溫傅降唐，餘眾悉平，定襄道十五年之戰至此收束。史書記載伏念與溫傅事後被檻送京城，至於兩人最終如何處置，各書記載不一，傳世多只強調「降而卒平」四字。裴行儉因功加授禮部尚書、檢校右衛大將軍，高宗並賜書與實俸；他在軍中收攏的降眾沒有解散，而是分置各道、給種糧牛羊，安置於朔方、河南一帶屯耕，令渠帥各率其部，務使既靖且耕。對唐廷而言，北方邊線由「以兵衛之」轉為「以撫守之」，定襄道自此成為唐王朝經營北疆的常設軍區與羈縻地帶，而不再只是臨時出征的集結點。次年（682）永淳元年四月，裴行儉病卒於軍中，年六十四，朝廷追贈幽州都督，諡曰憲。他生前所著的軍營行陣、部眾、料敵等四十六訣兵書，後來由武則天令秘書監武承嗣到其家中取進秘府，視為秘術；裴行儉以一場不流血的收束結束十五年邊戰，本身也成為唐代兵學中最被反覆講述的一段。
resultEn: In Kaiyao 1 (681) Pei Xingjian's counter-plot worked: Nasian Funi'an and Ashide Wenfu fell out with one another, Funi'an took Wenfu and surrendered to Tang, the remaining clans were all settled, and the fifteen years of war on the Dingxiang front came to an end. The histories record that Funi'an and Wenfu were sent to the capital under guard afterwards; how the two were finally disposed of is reported differently in different books, and what has come down to us usually says only that they surrendered and the affair ended. For his part Pei Xingjian was advanced to Minister of Rites and Inspector of the Right Imperial Guard, and Gaozong bestowed a writing and increased his stipend; the surrendered people he gathered were not disbanded but distributed among the circuits, given seed grain and cattle, settled in the Shaofang and Henan regions to plough and garrison, with their own chiefs each leading their own group, so that they might be both pacified and employed. For the Tang court this meant that the northern line changed from being guarded by troops to being held by pacification, and the Dingxiang circuit from then on became a standing military district and client zone in the management of the northern frontier rather than a mere point of assembly for temporary expeditions. In the following year, in the fourth month of Yongchun 1 (682), Pei Xingjian fell ill and died in the field, at sixty-four; the court posthumously granted him the office of Governor of Youzhou and the posthumous title of Xian. The military manual he had written, with its forty-six formulas on the battle array, on troops and on reading the enemy, was later taken into the secret archive on the order of Empress Wu, who sent the palace secretary Wu Chengsi to his house to fetch it, and was kept as a hidden technique. That a Pei Xingjian should close fifteen years of frontier war without a battle is itself one of the most frequently recounted episodes in Tang military history.
